source: I want to create a fully featured 3D low-poly go-kart racing game. It should have bright colors and a natural terrain setting. Work hard on creating a serene environment. It should take place on the edge of a mountain, and there should be a waterfall flowing off it.

image_prompt.text: Guardrails and low walls that physically block a kart from leaving the track, continuous along the cliff-edge sections
Curved track elements forcing clean direction reversals as the circuit doubles back along the mountainside
A wide standardised starting grid of evenly spaced kart slots so racers launch side by side without colliding
a winding go-kart track running along the edge of a mountain, with the drop on one side
a waterfall flowing off the mountain edge beside the track
bright low-poly natural terrain - grassy slopes, rocky outcrops, scattered stylised trees

layout_placement.text: Evenly spaced grid slots at the start-finish straight
Lap and split detection regions at the start-finish line and at key turns, for lap counting and cut-course checking

notes: Circuit was assumed over point-to-point: go-kart racing normally means laps, but the prompt never says so, and switching to a descent later changes the whole route.
Racing routes P6 by genre - the mountainside track is laid out procedurally first so it reads as one followable loop, then dressed.
The waterfall and cliff edge are the visual point of the prompt but no option covers landscape features; both went out as free text.

open_questions.ask: Is this a lap circuit you go round several times, or a single downhill run from the top of the mountain to the bottom?
How long should a lap take - about thirty seconds, or a couple of minutes?
How many karts race at once? The starting grid width depends on it.

theme: Bright low-poly stylised nature - saturated colours, serene mountain landscape

coverage_missing.ask: Lap circuit or one-way downhill descent?
How many racers at once, and how many laps?
Does serene mean quiet and empty, or is there trackside crowd and event dressing?

answers.ask: Is this a lap circuit you go round several times, or a single downhill run from the top of the mountain to the bottom?
answers.answer: Make it a lap circuit that loops around the mountain edge, so players race several laps while passing the waterfall.

answers.ask: How long should a lap take - about thirty seconds, or a couple of minutes?
answers.answer: Aim for about thirty seconds per lap to keep the first track compact and immediately playable.

answers.ask: How many karts race at once? The starting grid width depends on it.
answers.answer: Use 4 karts racing at once, including the player, for a small and clear starting grid.
